latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Batch Video Creator Free.  
- Create multiple videos automatically from images or clips with background music and text overlay.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, and more).
- Cloud-based, no installation required — results ready in 1–3 minutes.
- Credits system provides 100 free credits with anonymous sign-in.
- Simple workflows for marketers and creators to batch-produce content quickly.
